veranderings.voor: Daarna kom huise in die nuwe nedersetting by, saam met winkels, skole en ander dienste.
veranderings.na: Daarna kom daar huise, winkels, skole en ander dienste in die nuwe nedersetting by.
veranderings.rede: The separable verb 'kom ... by' is split around a long phrase and then followed by a tacked-on 'saam met' list; one list inside the verb frame reads more naturally with the same meaning.
